requirements.title: Assistance systems that help instead of irritating
requirements.statement: Speed-limit warning and lane assistance shall be switchable off with one press per drive, and the emergency brake shall not intervene without a real obstacle.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Driver assistance draws 24 rows with 17 defects (unexpected braking) and the speed-limit assistant 16 rows (14 usability) because it must be switched off after every start.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Software within the limits of EU safety regulation.

criteria.metric: Presses to switch off speed-limit warning and lane assistance

uncertainties: EU General Safety Regulation requires these systems to be active at every start; only the switch-off effort can change.

findings.title: Driver assistance, automated driving, overall technology: 24 complaints (recurring complaint)

requirements.title: Comfortable ride on poor road surfaces
requirements.statement: Non-M variants shall offer a comfort-oriented suspension that absorbs sharp bumps on poor European roads without losing the car's sporty handling.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Suspension and damping draw 41 complaint rows (2.2 %, 12 wishes for a softer ride) and the study scores ride comfort at 9.20 vs peer 9.73; adaptive suspension is standard only on the M135.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Damper tuning and an adaptive-suspension option fit the life-cycle impulse.

criteria.target: Available as option on all variants

findings.title: Quality of ride: weak study rating (9.2)
Cushioning / damping vehicle: wished or criticised, related equipment is optional or missing

requirements.title: Keep the sporty handling and the fuel economy in the next generation
requirements.statement: The successor shall keep the agile handling and the fuel economy that customers praise today.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Sportiness (9.34 vs peer 7.30) and fuel economy (9.30 vs 7.56) are the strongest study advantages; driving dynamics collects 415 likes. Strengths to protect.

findings.title: Fuel economy/ energy efficiency: strong study rating (9.3)
Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology: strength to keep (415 likes)

requirements.title: Reliable exterior lights and helpful door mirrors
requirements.statement: Exterior lights shall work without fault messages; door mirrors shall tilt down on the kerb side when reversing and fold automatically when locking.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Exterior lighting draws 26 rows with 19 defects (failed or falsely reported lamps); door mirrors 28 rows with 11 wishes for kerb tilt and auto-fold that previous 1 Series had.

requirements.title: Quiet tyres and wheels that are easy to clean
requirements.statement: Standard tyres shall keep road noise low on rough surfaces, and wheel designs shall be easy to clean and resist corrosion.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Wheels and tyres draw 34 complaint rows (15 defects): tyre noise, early corrosion and intricate wheel designs that are hard to clean.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Tyre sourcing and wheel design in the life-cycle impulse.

criteria.metric: EU tyre label noise class of standard tyres
Wheel corrosion reports in the first year

findings.title: Wheels / tires: wished or criticised, related equipment is optional or missing

requirements.title: No silent de-contenting against the previous 1 Series
requirements.statement: Items that loyal customers used on the previous generation (12 V socket in the boot, rear USB charging, mirror kerb tilt, dual-zone climate, fog lights, glove-box light) shall stay standard on the comparable trim, or the change shall be shown clearly at configuration.
requirements.recommend_rationale: The general equipment theme draws 73 complaint rows with 35 wishes, mostly from repeat buyers listing features that were standard on the F40 and are now missing or optional.

criteria.metric: Listed items standard on the M Sport trim
Complaint rows about missing standard equipment

uncertainties: Cost impact not quantified; rough effort follows in Phase 5.

findings.title: Body equipment, overall technology: 73 complaints (recurring complaint)

requirements.title: Supportive, durable seats with lumbar adjustment
requirements.statement: The front seats shall support the back on long drives, offer lumbar adjustment on the volume trims and keep their stitching and shape over the warranty period.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Seats draw 50 complaint rows with 24 defects (stitching, loss of shape, squeaks) and comfort complaints about M Sport seats; active seats are an option on all six variants.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Seat trim, foam and lumbar option within the life-cycle impulse.

criteria.target: Available on every trim with electric seats

findings.title: Seats: wished or criticised, related equipment is optional or missing

requirements.title: Dual-zone climate as standard and rear ventilation
requirements.statement: Driver and passenger temperatures shall be adjustable independently on every variant, the display shall not suggest zones that are not fitted, and rear passengers shall get air vents.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Climatisation (24 rows), climate control panel (24) and climate settings (17, nine wishes) describe synced temperatures that cannot be split and a display that looks dual-zone; the study scores climate control at 7.31 vs peer 8.13, the largest interior gap.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Software activation plus standard-content decision; rear vents in the life-cycle impulse.

findings.title: Air conditioning control panel: 24 complaints (recurring complaint)
Heating/ ventilation/ air conditioning: weak study rating (7.3)

requirements.title: Cockpit lighting without reflections in the mirrors and windscreen
requirements.statement: Ambient and display lighting shall not reflect in the side mirrors, side windows or windscreen at night at any brightness setting.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Instrument panel complaints (33 rows, 11 defects) include repeated reports that dash and ambient lights reflect in the door mirrors and windscreen at night, which owners call a safety issue.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Light guide and default brightness changes.

criteria.metric: Visible reflection of interior lighting in the side mirrors at night

requirements.title: Physical controls for climate and a rotary controller option
requirements.statement: Temperature, fan and seat or steering wheel heating shall have physical controls, and a rotary controller (or an equivalent haptic control) shall operate map zoom, lists and shortcuts so the driver does not have to aim at the touch screen while driving.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Touch screen operation is the largest complaint theme of the F70 in Europe (141 rows, 7.4 % of all complaints, 91 usability); 25 owners explicitly ask for the iDrive controller back and the operating concept adds 30 rows. Many describe touch-only climate control as unsafe.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Physical climate keys and a controller are a life-cycle-impulse change of the centre console.

criteria.metric: Climate temperature and fan operable without the touch screen
Glance time for a temperature change while driving

findings.title: Operating concept, operating system: 30 complaints (recurring complaint)

requirements.title: Stable infotainment and settings that survive updates
requirements.statement: The central display and connected functions shall not freeze, go blank or reboot in normal use, and over-the-air updates shall keep all personal settings.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Connected drive and infotainment technology draws 107 complaint rows with 51 defects (blank screens, freezes, lost functions); software updates add 13 rows with 9 defects that wiped settings, and the study scores connected services at 7.36 vs peer 7.62.

criteria.metric: User settings kept after an OTA update

findings.title: ConnectedDrive and Infotainment, overall technology: 107 complaints (recurring complaint)

requirements.title: Functions bought with the car stay included for the first owner
requirements.statement: Functions that are fitted and shown at handover (high-beam assistant, traffic information, 3D maps, media apps) shall stay active for the first owner without a subscription, and any time-limited content shall be stated clearly at the point of sale.
requirements.recommend_rationale: 47 complaint rows about connected upgrades, all usability: functions such as automatic high beam and live traffic switch off after three months; the catalogue lists Digital Premium as time-limited (480 EUR option). Owners feel misled and say they will change brand.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Offer and licensing decision; no hardware change.

criteria.metric: Hardware-enabled safety and lighting functions behind a subscription

uncertainties: Touches the digital revenue model; needs a commercial decision beyond the product scope.

findings.title: BMW ConnectedDrive upgrades/ MINI CONNECTED upgrades: 47 complaints (recurring complaint)
ConnectedDrive and Infotainment, overall technology: wished or criticised, related equipment is optional or missing

requirements.title: Printed quick-start handbook and better in-car help
requirements.statement: Every car shall be delivered with a printed, model-specific quick-start handbook, and the in-car manual shall be searchable and show only the functions fitted to the car.
requirements.recommend_rationale: The owner's manual is the third-largest digital complaint (86 rows, 37 wishes for a printed handbook); older owners report being unable to use functions without it.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Content and print; no vehicle change.

requirements.title: Music from USB sticks
requirements.statement: The USB-C ports shall play audio files from a USB stick, without requiring a smartphone.
requirements.recommend_rationale: 30 complaint rows, 17 wishes: owners copied their CDs to USB sticks and lost playback with the new generation; several say USB only charges.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Software (media player and USB data path), possibly a hub change in the life-cycle impulse.

criteria.metric: Playback of MP3 and AAC from a FAT32 or exFAT USB stick

requirements.title: Navigation route choice and clear guidance
requirements.statement: Navigation shall offer fastest, shortest and road-type preferences, avoid single-track lanes on main routes and keep map zoom operable without the touch screen.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Navigation draws 29 complaint rows (11 defects) about routes through narrow lanes and missing route options; the study scores navigation at 8.30 vs peer 8.71.

findings.title: Integrated navigation system: weak study rating (8.3)

requirements.title: Smooth dual-clutch gearbox and immediate response when pulling away
requirements.statement: The car shall pull away without a perceptible delay or jerk, including when the throttle is pressed while still rolling, and the gearbox shall shift smoothly at low speed and when cold.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Drivetrain complaints (123 rows, 6.5 %, 73 usability) and transmission complaints (48 rows, 12 defects) describe a dead spot when pulling away at junctions and jerky DCT behaviour; the study scores acceleration at 8.21 vs 8.90.

criteria.metric: Delay from throttle input to traction when rolling below 10 km/h

requirements.title: Quiet, solid-feeling cabin without rattles
requirements.statement: Doors and interior trim shall be free of rattles and buzzing, and the cabin noise at motorway speed shall match the premium compact segment.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Front door complaints (16 rows, 13 defects: buzzing, rattles) support the study gaps in quietness (7.62 vs peer 8.79, the largest gap of the car) and build quality (7.95 vs 8.23).

criteria.target: Segment benchmark (value to be set by engineering)

findings.title: Quietness when driving: weak study rating (7.62)
Overall build quality: weak study rating (7.95)

requirements.title: Practical boot with power tailgate and luggage fixtures
requirements.statement: The boot shall offer tie-down points, a 12 V socket and a parcel shelf that stays in place; the tailgate shall close from a button on the lid where a power tailgate is fitted.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Luggage compartment (23 rows), trunk lid (15 defects) and tailgate operation (19 rows, 12 wishes) complaints match the study gaps in cargo capacity (7.07 vs 7.47) and loading ease (7.50 vs 7.95); the power tailgate is an option on all variants.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Boot fixtures and offer changes in the life-cycle impulse.

criteria.metric: Tie-down points and 12 V socket in the boot
